proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1395 article gives Malayalam kaṟa blackness, spot, stain, rust; kaṟu black; kaṟukka to grow black; kaṟuppu blackness; kāṟu darkness, black, cloud.. The Byari survey form karuppu “black” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.

The Byari survey form kari “burn (something)” is proposed within this article family.
